title: Stability and Perron's method for Monge solutions of eikonal equations in metric spaces
summary: The main result of this paper concerns the stability of Monge solutions to eikonal equations in metric spaces. Although the subslope used in the standard definition of Monge solutions is, in general, not stable under uniform convergence, we overcome this difficulty by introducing an equivalent nonlocal characterization based on sphere-wise subslope conditions.
